entries.en:
“As a nutritional therapist specialized in female hormones, I’m extremely careful about what I put into my body. Hormones are sensitive. Stress, toxins, poor-quality ingredients — they all add up. So I don’t just look at labels, I look at what something will do inside the body.

I choose Karmicare because I trust what’s in it — and what’s not. No unnecessary fillers, no hidden disruptors. Just clean, purposeful ingredients that support rather than burden the nervous system and hormonal balance. When you understand how delicate the female endocrine system can be, especially under chronic stress, quality isn’t optional.

And that’s also why I use it in my practice.

I work with women dealing with PMS, cycle issues, stress-related fatigue, estrogen dominance and adrenal dysregulation. I need products that are technically sound — bioavailable, well-formulated, and supportive of detox pathways and nervous system regulation.

Karmicare fits that standard.”

entries.en: Everything people usually ask before switching to a day-and-night oral care system.
entries.fr: Tout ce que l’on demande généralement avant de passer à un système de soin bucco-dentaire jour et nuit.

entries.en: Why two formulas instead of one?

Because your mouth doesn’t do the same job all day. Daytime is exposure — acids, sugars, coffee — so Awake protects, activates and brightens. Night is repair — saliva drops and your body regenerates — so Asleep soothes, rebalances and remineralises while you sleep.
entries.fr: Parce que votre bouche ne fait pas le même travail toute la journée. Le jour, c’est l’exposition — acides, sucres, café —, alors Awake protège, active et éclaircit. La nuit, c’est la réparation — la salive diminue et votre corps se régénère —, alors Asleep apaise, rééquilibre et reminéralise pendant votre sommeil.

entries.en: How quickly will I notice a difference?
entries.fr: En combien de temps vais-je remarquer une différence ?

entries.en: Mineral remineralisation takes time — most members feel the sensitivity shift in 2–4 weeks and see visible brightening in 4–6. The ritual shift happens faster: you notice the bookend effect within the first week — a morning moment that wakes you up, an evening moment that winds you down.
entries.fr: La reminéralisation prend du temps — la plupart des membres sentent leur sensibilité évoluer en 2 à 4 semaines et voient un éclat visible en 4 à 6 semaines. Le changement de rituel est plus rapide : dès la première semaine, vous remarquez l’effet de ces deux rendez-vous — un moment le matin qui vous réveille, un moment le soir qui vous apaise.
entries.notes: 'the bookend effect' rendered 'l'effet de ces deux rendez-vous' (the literal 'serre-livres' does not read in French). Claims C24 need Clinical Research sign-off; translated faithfully, not softened.
